statements.impact_statement: braces is reached only through @graphql-codegen/cli (a frontend devDependency run by hand via `npm run codegen`), through micromatch and @graphql-tools' globby/fast-glob, to expand the document globs hard-coded in frontend/codegen.ts (src/**/*.ts, src/**/*.tsx). No user or network input reaches braces, and no production image contains it: the backend image installs --omit=dev and the frontend image ships only the static build. No braces release fixes the advisory (3.0.3 is the latest), and every @graphql-codegen/cli release depends on micromatch.
